nb.editorSettings.blockColorsHelp.message: Customize the primary color of each block category.

nb.editorSettings.blockFlyoutBlurHelp.message: The intensity, in pixels, of the blur effect behind the toolbox.

nb.editorSettings.canvasSizeMultiplierHe.message: How large the canvas is in the paint editor relative to the stage.

nb.editorSettings.compactTabsHelp.message: Removes the text from tabs, leaving just the icon.

nb.editorSettings.cornerSizeHelp.message: Controls how rounded the corners of blocks are.

nb.editorSettings.customBlockShapeHelp.message: Adjust the padding, corner radius, notch height, and field height of blocks.

nb.editorSettings.darkModeHelp.message: Turns the website dark to make it easier on the eyes.

nb.editorSettings.deselectBlockSelection.message: Clears selected blocks after you act on them. When disabled, selections remain until you click elsewhere.

nb.editorSettings.disableCompilerHelp.message: Disables the {APP_NAME} compiler by default. It can still be manually enabled per-project through Edit > Advanced Settings.

nb.editorSettings.disableInspectBlockHel.message: Removes the Inspect Block item from the right-click context menu on blocks.

nb.editorSettings.enableDebuggerHelp.message: Enables a debugger panel and extension that allows you to inspect logs and monitor performance. The debugger contains the most functionality with the compiler disabled.

nb.editorSettings.encodingBitRateHelp.message: Defines the bit rate for sounds encoded in NitroBolt.

nb.editorSettings.extendableArrowsLeftHe.message: Moves the arrows of expandable blocks from the right side to the left side.

nb.editorSettings.fieldHeightHelp.message: Controls the height of text inputs and dropdowns inside blocks, independent of overall padding.

nb.editorSettings.fullScreenCatalogModal.message: Makes modals like the extension catalog full screen.

nb.editorSettings.help.description: Hover text of help icon in settings

nb.editorSettings.hiddenCategoriesHelp.message: Choose which default categories to show or hide in the block toolbox.

nb.editorSettings.hideBackpackHelp.message: Removes the backpack from the bottom of the screen.

nb.editorSettings.hideExtendableArrowSep.message: Hides the middle line between arrows on extendables that accept arrays.

nb.editorSettings.hideFeedbackHelp.message: Removes the feedback button from the top of the screen.

nb.editorSettings.hidePauseHelp.message: Removes the pause button from the project controls.

nb.editorSettings.inwardSelectionHelp.message: Requires blocks or scripts to be fully enclosed by the selection box. When disabled, touching them is enough.

nb.editorSettings.labelContrastThreshold.message: Sets how bright a block color must be before its text label switches to dark for readability. Lower values use dark text less often, higher values use dark text more often.

nb.editorSettings.legacyModalsHelp.message: Uses TurboWarp's modal style instead of the modern style.

nb.editorSettings.maxCornerRadiusHelp.message: Sets an upper limit on the corner radius as a multiple of the base corner size, used by round output blocks.

nb.editorSettings.modalOpenAnimationHelp.message: Makes modals fade into view instead of being a sharp cut.

nb.editorSettings.modalOverlayBlurHelp.message: The intensity, in pixels, of the blur effect on the UI behind modals.

nb.editorSettings.noCutButtonHelp.message: Hides the cut to clipboard button.

nb.editorSettings.noSwapButtonHelp.message: Hides the fill and outline swap button.

nb.editorSettings.notchSizeHelp.message: Controls how tall the notches and bumps that let blocks snap together are.

nb.editorSettings.nudgeMultiplierHelp.message: How far selected objects move when pressing Shift+Arrow keys in the paint editor.

nb.editorSettings.paddingSizeHelp.message: Controls the overall size and spacing of blocks.

nb.editorSettings.pixelUploadSizeHelp.message: Toggle whether Bitmap file uploads in the paint editor are doubled or not, and change how it displays their sizes.

nb.editorSettings.stageLeftHelp.message: Swaps the stage and the block palette.

nb.editorSettings.swapMultiSelectModifie.message: Uses Ctrl for selecting whole scripts and Shift for selecting individual blocks.

nb.editorSettings.unrestrictUnsandboxed.message: Allow all extensions to load unsandboxed

nb.editorSettings.unrestrictUnsandboxedH.message: Disables extension security prompts and runs all extensions without the sandbox, including extension imports, URL parameter extensions, and project-loaded extensions. This is dangerous and should only be enabled if you fully trust all loaded extensions.

nb.editorSettings.username.mustChange.message: Sorry, the cloud variable server thinks your username may be unsafe. Please change it to something else or {resetIt}.

nb.editorSettings.usernameHelp.message: This value will be stored in your browser's storage. It may be logged when you interact with projects that contain cloud variables. It will also be used for Live Collaboration.

nb.editorSettings.usernameHelp2.message: Values that do not correspond to a valid Scratch account will typically be rejected by the cloud variable server. We recommend leaving it as-is or changing it to your Scratch username.

nb.editorSettings.vanillaPaletteHelp.message: Hides NitroBolt-exclusive blocks and hides the JSON and assets categories.

nb.editorSettings.versionControl.fillPre.message: Fill in the previous commit message

nb.editorSettings.viewCounterHelp.message: When you start a project that is loaded from Scratch, this may be logged so that a view counter can be incremented over time. Views are anonymous and can not be tied back to any user.

nb.editorSettings.visibleTabsHelp.message: Choose which tabs to show in the editor. Hidden tabs can still be accessed via keyboard shortcuts.

nb.editorSettings.waveformColorHelp.message: If checked, waveforms will display a volume gradient where green is quieter and red is louder.

nb.editorSettings.waveformRenderTypeHelp.message: Choose between sharp edges on sound waveforms or soft edges like in Scratch. Sharp edges can offer more detail on large sounds.
